answer: To admit a new key, the applicant posts twelve reproducible task hashes. Three established reviewers, drawn at random from a rotating public atlas of eligible miners, each re-run one listed task and publish a yes/no signal plus the output hash. Admission requires three matching hashes and that no reviewer has signed more than two admissions this epoch. Any peer can attest by recounting those published signatures and re-executing a listed task. A reused or forged review cipher is rejected when hashes collide or a reviewer cap is exceeded.
